tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for the marketplace, workspace and admin console. Light is the brief's paper white.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Zebra rows in DataTable, sunken panels and the kitchen queue columns. Light is the brief's alternate table row; dark reuses the brief's navy.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, order tickets, sheets and the sticky cart bar. Sits on surface or surface-alt and is set apart by a line border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface, surface-alt, surface-raised, brand-soft, amber-soft, danger-soft and neutral-soft (12:1 or better in both themes). Light is the brief's text colour.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, cuisine tags, captions, the 'last updated' line. Reads on surface, surface-alt, surface-raised, brand-soft and neutral-soft (5.5:1 or better). Light is the brief's subtitle and footer slate.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card borders that carry no meaning on their own. Never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, steppers, secondary buttons and upcoming timeline dots: 3:1 or better on surface, surface-alt and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: DataTable cell borders, at 1px. Light keeps the brief's black table rule exactly.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Structural fill: DataTable header row, kitchen ticket header, the workspace top bar. Light is the brief's table-header navy. Text on it is on-navy.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a navy fill (15.9:1 light, 12:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: DineFlow teal: primary buttons, the wordmark, section headings, active and in-progress states, links. As text it reads on surface and surface-alt (4.57:1 light). On brand-soft the brief's own pair is 4.29:1, so use brand-strong for text there below 19px bold.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Teal text at small sizes on brand-soft (5.3:1 light, 7.3:1 dark) and on surface: callout titles, eyebrows, status pill labels. A darker step of brand added for legibility.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Info callouts, the Preparing and Payment confirmed pills, the selected prep-time preset. Light is the brief's 'Important interpretation' callout tint.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Labels and glyphs on a brand fill: the primary button, the Ready for collection pill (4.83:1 light, 7.48:1 dark).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Waiting and caution: borders and glyphs of waiting states, the new-order header. Light is the brief's warning-callout title colour; as text it is 4.31:1 on surface and 3.94:1 on amber-soft, so it is kept for borders, glyphs and text 19px bold or larger. Small text uses amber-strong.

tokens.name: amber-strong
tokens.usage: Amber text at small sizes on amber-soft and surface (5.3:1 light, 8.6:1 dark): warning callout titles, Payment pending and Awaiting pills. A darker step of amber added for legibility.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Warning callouts, the new-order ticket header, Refund initiated and Paused pills. Light is the brief's 'Do not hard-code a money flow' callout tint.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Stopped states and destructive actions: Rejected, Cancelled, Payment failed, Offline, the Reject button, field errors. As text it reads on surface, surface-alt and danger-soft (5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error callouts and the Rejected pill, behind danger or ink text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill: the Reject button (6.6:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Finished or inactive states: Collected, Refund completed, Closed, Unavailable. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: tenant
tokens.usage: A restaurant's own colour on its storefront: logo tile, the restaurant header band. Defaults to brand; a storefront overrides it only after the admin contrast check (see Restaurant storefronts). Never used for status.

tokens.name: on-tenant
tokens.usage: Text on a tenant fill. Overridden together with tenant, and must reach 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour, drawn by the focus-ring shadow. 3:1 or better on every surface and tint in both themes.

families.sans: Carlito, Lato, Calibri, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: Noto Serif, the brief's text and title face. Bold for the mark and titles, regular for the lede.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product mark, set in caps in brand. There is no drawn logo.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the marketplace greeting, a restaurant's name on its profile, admin page titles.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Order ahead, then collect when it’s ready.
styles.usage: The line under a display title, in ink-muted.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Carlito, the brief's heading face, carries every control, label and number so kitchen staff can scan at a glance.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen headings in the workspace and admin console, in ink.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings: menu categories, queue groups, settings sections. In brand, like the brief's numbered subheads.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, menu item names, restaurant names on cards, form labels.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Input values, list metadata, prices in running UI.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Status pills, timestamps, helper text under fields. The smallest size for anything a person must act on.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Order numbers and ages on kitchen tickets, totals at checkout. Always with tabular figures.

styles.name: pickup-code
styles.usage: The pickup code only, shown to the customer at the counter.

groups.name: Reading
groups.note: The brief's running text: Noto Serif at a comfortable 1.5 leading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pilau with kachumbari and a side of sukuma wiki. Ask the counter for extra chilli.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, policies, notification text, order notes. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Customer self-cancellation is available only before the restaurant accepts.
styles.usage: Menu item descriptions, DataTable cells, callout bodies on narrow screens.

styles.name: callout-title
styles.usage: Callout titles, in brand-strong, amber-strong or danger to match the callout tone.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Set in caps, in brand-strong: the running location line above a screen title, as in the brief's page header.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Set in caps, in ink-muted: receipt footers and metadata lines, as in the brief's page footer.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use gap on flex and grid rows rather than margins.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap inside pills and buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between pills, between a label and its field, timeline row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button side padding, between items in a ticket.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and ticket padding, the phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards in a list, between form groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above a screen title on tablet and desktop.

radius.note: The brief is square: tables, callouts and its accent bar have no rounding. Controls take a slight radius; only status pills are round.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: DataTable, Callout, the wordmark's accent bar: the brief's square edges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, steppers, prep-time presets, logo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Restaurant cards, menu item images, order tickets, the pickup code frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills only, so a rounded shape always means status.

size.note: Touch targets come from the brief's 'large touch targets' and 'few clicks for kitchen staff'.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable in the marketplace.

tokens.name: touch-kitchen
tokens.usage: Height of primary actions in the restaurant workspace: Accept, Reject, Mark ready, prep-time presets.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the marketplace column and checkout on wide screens.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows: only things that float over content get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The sticky cart bar, bottom sheets and menus that float over the page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px of solid focus teal. Applied with :focus-visible.
